evals.prompt: Set up a harness task where every milestone must pass $audit before it is marked done.
evals.expected_output: The harness config writes an executable review check, not prose or raw fanout.
expectations: checks[] includes kind: review
checks[].action starts with /audit
the review gate is conditional on milestone_exit or equivalent
reviewer count and fanout mechanics are not encoded in harness config prose

evals.prompt: Resume a harness carrier whose state.jsonl tail is task_disposed but it lacks a preceding harness_stopped and uses result: completed.
evals.expected_output: The harness treats it as terminal legacy/audit state and does not enter the run loop.
expectations: reports a legacy terminal warning
does not reopen the disposed task
does not edit historical ledger lines

evals.prompt: Resume a 90-round active harness task with repeated strategy_updated(reason: reopen), pass-no-matches gates, and a context.md that lists every round.
evals.expected_output: The harness routes through repair/normalization and prunes display context without losing ledger audit history.
expectations: classifies reason: reopen and semantic gate values as legacy evidence
new state writes use pass|fail|escalated gate values
context.md keeps current handoff pointers instead of a per-round catalog

evals.prompt: Set up a sequence of dependent future harness tasks from one long external RFC.
evals.expected_output: The harness avoids full materialization of all future carriers and deduplicates stable setup sources.
expectations: creates only the next executable carrier by default or uses lean pending carriers
reuses digest-addressed shared setup snapshots for identical external sources
records relevant sections or scoped extracts for long structured plans

evals.prompt: Set up/run a multi-milestone harness task from terse goal plus motivation: fix export flow because enterprise users abandon repeated timeout regressions.
evals.expected_output: Harness records task why in setup and carries it into Propose rounds and audit capsules.
expectations: planning_context includes motivation, or asks when absent motivation affects scope
milestones[].rationale links each milestone to task motivation
Propose reads motivation and milestone rationale before scoping
audit capsule includes task motivation plus milestone/approach rationale

evals.prompt: Set up a harness task for a non-very-simple backend change: update the export flow across API handler, queue worker, and retry state so timeout regressions stop. The user does not mention audit.
evals.expected_output: Harness proposes deterministic checks plus an executable final audit review gate by default, avoiding risk circularity.
expectations: checks[] includes a kind: review gate with action starting /audit
the audit gate has stage or selector equivalent to final
the audit gate is conditional on final_exit or equivalent, not every round by default
deterministic command checks remain present and are not replaced by audit

evals.prompt: Set up a harness task to fix one misspelled label in a single README line, with an obvious grep check.
evals.expected_output: Harness may omit audit for a very-simple mechanical task and records the narrow reason.
expectations: does not require a default audit gate for the mechanical single-file task
checks[] still contains at least one deterministic command or equivalent verification
the omission reason is narrow: very-simple, mechanical, covered by deterministic check
